change_summary: Replace verbose {{ domain_policy }} with the authoritative compact {{ policy_summary }} in the system prompt.
reason_for_change: The compact policy_summary checklist was already accepted as authoritative and proven to reduce cost. The system prompt still re-sends the full domain_policy verbatim on all 27 turns/task, inflating input tokens (the dominant cost driver given many turns vs. few tool calls). Referencing the summary instead cuts re-sent input tokens every turn while preserving the authoritative rules, so success should hold and mean cost per task drops.
